text: The major is designed to train professionals with solid knowledge of math and physics, basic theory and methods of electronics and information systems. They should be familiar with computer application technology after strictly trained in scientific research experiments. They are qualified in information science, electronic engineering, computer technology or other related fields. Focusing on the combination of theory and technology, and technology and system, under the support of the advantage in the information and communications technology and information and communication system integration, it trains professionals to have a solid theoretical basis in information science, to be familiar with the design, development and integration technology of information system, so that they are capable of design, development, maintenance in the IT industry, the community dedicated information systems and networks.
